lines.japanese: 『はい』を押そうとして、そういえば昔迷惑メールについて、森里君がクラスメイトと話していたことがあるのを思い出した。
lines.english: As I reached for YES, I remembered Morisato once talking with some classmates about spam messages.

lines.japanese: 内容はほんとに繋がるのか、誰かやってみろというものだったけど、問題はそのときの会話じゃない。森里君だ。
lines.english: They had been daring somebody to find out whether the link really worked. But that conversation was beside the point. Morisato was the point.

lines.japanese: そうだ、僕には頼りになる親友がいるじゃないか。クラスのみんなに好かれていて、発言力もある森里君。
lines.english: Of course. I had a dependable best friend. Morisato—liked by everyone in class, a boy whose words carried weight.

lines.japanese: 震える手で電話帳を開き、僕は登録番号「０２」を押した。
lines.english: With trembling hands, I opened my contacts and pressed entry number 02.

lines.japanese: かかかと笑う、親友の高らかな声が聞きたい。いますぐ聞きたい。はやく出てくれないかな。
lines.english: I wanted to hear my best friend's ringing ka-ka-ka laugh. I wanted to hear it now. Wouldn't he please pick up soon?

lines.japanese: いきなり相談は悪いから、まずは入院中の様子でも聞こう。あとは森里君の好きなサッカーの話をして、足立アナの話をして、あとは片思い中だっていう可愛い幼馴染みさんの話も聞こう。
lines.english: It would be rude to spring my troubles on him, so first I would ask how he was doing in the hospital. Then we could talk about his beloved soccer, and Adachi, the announcer, and I could ask about the cute childhood friend he said he had an unrequited crush on.

lines.japanese: 「留守番電話にお繋ぎします」
lines.english: “Connecting you to voicemail.”

lines.japanese: 「おかけになったお客様は、電波の届かない場所におられるか、電源が入っておりません。ピーという発信音のあとに……」
lines.english: “The person you are calling is either outside the service area or has their phone switched off. After the tone...”

lines.japanese: 繋がらなかった。そんな馬鹿な。一体いつになったら森里君の電話は繋がるというんだろう。
lines.english: It had not connected. That was absurd. When in the world would Morisato's phone ever connect?

lines.japanese: 「メッセージはいっぱいです」
lines.english: “The mailbox is full.”

lines.japanese: 留守番電話すら拒否されて、僕は携帯電話を持った手をだらんと下に落とした。
lines.english: Denied even by his voicemail, I let the hand holding my phone fall limply to my side.

lines.japanese: 「あれ？　おかしいな、繋がらないよ」
lines.english: “Huh? That's strange. It won't connect.”

lines.japanese: 「繋がらないよ！」
lines.english: “It won't connect!”

lines.japanese: どうしていつまでたっても電波が通じないんだろう。そうだ、もしかしたらケータイの調子が悪いのかもしれない。
lines.english: Why could I never get a signal, no matter how long I waited? Of course. Perhaps there was something wrong with my phone.

lines.japanese: 「繋がらないよ！　電波が繋がらないよ！」
lines.english: “It won't connect! The signal won't connect!”

lines.japanese: 携帯ショップだ、今からならまだ間に合うかもしれない。
lines.english: A phone shop. If I went now, perhaps I could still make it in time.

lines.japanese: どこだ、携帯ショップはどこにあるんだっけ。そうだ、駅前まで行けばあるに違いない。
lines.english: Where? Where was the phone shop again? Of course—there had to be one by the station.

lines.japanese: 「うっ、うぐうっ、ううううぅっ……」
lines.english: “Ngh... nnngh... uuuugh...”

lines.japanese: 「おかあさーん、あのひと、泣きながら走ってるよ」
lines.english: “Mommy, that man is running and crying.”

lines.japanese: 「しッ！　何見てるの！」
lines.english: “Shh! What are you staring at?”

lines.japanese: 「うぐっ、う、うわあああっ！」
lines.english: “Ngh... uwaaaah!”

lines.japanese: 僕は周りが見えなくなり、流れる景色も気にならなくなり、全力で駅前に向けて駆けた。
lines.english: I lost sight of everything around me, stopped noticing the scenery streaming past, and ran for the station with all my strength.

lines.japanese: 駅前の道路はいつだってひとであふれているから、その隙間を縫うのは大変だ。
lines.english: The streets around the station were always overflowing with people. Threading my way through the gaps was hard.

lines.japanese: いくら僕が急いでいると言ってもひとにぶつかるのは失礼なことだから、ちゃんと避けないといけないよね。
lines.english: However great my hurry, it would be rude to bump into people. I had to make sure I didn’t.

lines.japanese: 「繋がらない……電波が繋がらないよ……」
lines.english: “It won't connect... The signal won't connect...”

lines.japanese: 「携帯ショップに行けば繋がるはずなんだ……早く森里君に電話したいなあっ」
lines.english: “If I go to the phone shop, it should connect... I want to call Morisato soon...”

lines.japanese: だけど僕が急いでることが伝わったのか、周りのひとが僕の前に道を開いていく。
lines.english: But perhaps they could tell how desperately I was hurrying, because the people around me opened a path ahead.

lines.japanese: 「すみません、すみませんっ、ううっ、うっ……」
lines.english: “I'm sorry, excuse me... Nngh... ngh...”

lines.japanese: やさしい、やさしいひとばかりだ。この世界はやっぱりやさしいひとで満たされてるじゃないか。
lines.english: Kind. They were all such kind people. This world really was filled with kind people after all.

lines.japanese: 確かあの薬局の隣に携帯ショップがあったはずだ。これで森里君に電話できる！
lines.english: There was supposed to be a phone shop beside that drugstore. Now I could call Morisato!

lines.japanese: 「３－Ａの羽田鷹志です！　やってますか！」
lines.english: “I'm Takashi Haneda from Class 3-A! Are you open?!”

lines.japanese: 僕は携帯ショップの下りているシャッターを見て、何度も何度もそれをがしゃんがしゃんと叩いた。店の周りには広告のチラシやお勧めのプランが何枚も貼ってあるのに、何でやってないんだ！
lines.english: The phone shop's shutter was down. I pounded it again and again, making the metal crash and rattle. The storefront was plastered with flyers and recommended plans, so why wasn't it open?!

lines.japanese: 「おかしいって！　なんで今日やってないんだよ！」
lines.english: “This is wrong! Why aren't you open today?!”

lines.japanese: だんだん頭の中にノイズみたいなざらついた音が紛れこんできた。邪魔されてこんなに腹が立ったのは初めてだ。
lines.english: Little by little, a rough sound like static began seeping into my head. I had never been so furious at being obstructed.

lines.japanese: 「嫌がらせするなよ！　今日だけでいいから、開けろっ、開けろっつってんだろおっ！」
lines.english: “Stop tormenting me! Just for today—open up! Open up! I said open the hell up!”

lines.japanese: 「うわあああっ！　うわ、うわあああああっ！」
lines.english: “Uwaaaah! Uwa—uwaaaaaah!”

lines.japanese: がしゃん！　がしゃん！　がしゃん！　がしゃん！　がしゃん！
lines.english: Crash! Crash! Crash! Crash! Crash!

lines.japanese: どうしてだ、この世界では何一つ僕の思い通りにならないじゃないか。ふざけるなよ。
lines.english: Why? Nothing in this world ever went the way I wanted. Don't screw with me.

lines.japanese: いくらなんでも、この仕打ちはないだろう。僕は誰かと話をしたいだけなのに。
lines.english: This was too much. All I wanted was to talk to somebody.

lines.japanese: 「森里くん、森里くぅん！　森里、森里っ、森里くぅぅん！　開けてくれよ森里君、森里っ……」
lines.english: “Morisato... Morisatooo! Morisato, Morisato! Morisatoooo! Open up, Morisato! Morisato...”

lines.japanese: 「……なにしてんだァ、おまえ」
lines.english: “...What the hell are you doing?”

lines.japanese: 「えっ？　あっ……」
lines.english: “What? Oh...”

lines.japanese: 「あ、ああっ……」
「針生さん！」
lines.english: “Hariu!”

lines.japanese: 振りかえれば頼れる同級生がいた。
lines.english: I turned around. There stood a classmate I could depend upon.

lines.japanese: 「う、ううっ、ひぐっ、うぐう……うわあああっ！」
lines.english: “Ngh... hic... ugh... uwaaaah!”

lines.japanese: 「陛下？」
lines.english: “Your Majesty?”

lines.japanese: 「……じゃア、ないのか。はン、どうした羽田ァ。おまえ何時間か見ない間に、随分愉快になったもんだなァ」
lines.english: “...No, guess not. Hah. What's happened to you, Hanedaaa? You've gotten awfully entertaining in the few hours since I saw you last.”

lines.japanese: 「は、話を聞いてください、針生さん」
lines.english: “P-please listen to me, Hariu.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、いいぜ。しかし、まァ……相当派手にやったみたいだなァ、人目が集まりすぎてる。おい、ちょっと付きあえ」
lines.english: “Sure, why not. But... looks like you put on quite a show. We've got way too many eyes on us. Come on. Walk with me.”

lines.japanese: 「はは、でも電波が繋がらないんですよ」
lines.english: “Ha ha. But the signal won't connect.”

lines.japanese: 「いいから、来い」
lines.english: “Just come.”

lines.japanese: 針生さんの腕が首に巻きついたかと思うと、そのままぐいと引っぱられた。
lines.english: Hariu's arm looped around my neck, and then he hauled me sharply toward him.

lines.japanese: 僕はとと、とよろめくように歩きだしながら、針生さんに無理矢理引きずられていった。
lines.english: I tottered into motion and was dragged bodily away by Hariu.

lines.japanese: 「飲め」
lines.english: “Drink.”

lines.japanese: 針生さんの手から放物線を描いて何かが飛んできた。が、僕が手を出さなかったので、それは胸に当たって地面に落ち、ころころと転がった。
lines.english: Something flew from Hariu's hand in a high arc. I did not put out my hands, so it struck my chest, fell to the ground, and rolled away.

lines.japanese: 「いえ、あの、それどころじゃないんです……」
lines.english: “No, um... I have more important things to worry about...”

lines.japanese: 「ちっ」
lines.english: “Tch.”

lines.japanese: 針生さんはそれを拾いあげると、ぎゅるっと一気にキャップを外して、僕の頭の上に浴びせかけた。
lines.english: Hariu picked it up, twisted off the cap, and poured the water over my head.

lines.japanese: 「わわっ、わっ！」
lines.english: “Wah! Ah!”

lines.japanese: 「お目覚めいかがァ、チェリーボーイ？」
lines.english: “How’s that for a wake-up call, virgin?”

lines.japanese: 「ぶぐっ！」
lines.english: “Bgh!”

lines.japanese: 頭の水が収まったと思ったら、今度は開いた口の中にペットボトルを突っこまれた。針生さんの手がボトルの底を持ちあげ、無理矢理水を流しこんでくる。
lines.english: No sooner had the water stopped pouring over my head than he shoved the bottle into my open mouth. Hariu lifted the bottom and forced the water down my throat.

lines.japanese: 「げばっ！　かっ、かはっ！」
lines.english: “Gah! Kh—kah!”

lines.japanese: 鼻から水が飛びだした辺りで、針生さんはペットボトルを引きぬいてくれた。多分、空になったからだと思う。
lines.english: When water began shooting out of my nose, Hariu finally pulled the bottle free. Probably because it was empty.

lines.japanese: 「ごほっ、ごほっ……」
lines.english: “Cough, cough...”

lines.japanese: 「ひ、酷いですよ……ごほっ、何するんですか」
lines.english: “Th-that was awful... Cough. What did you do that for?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、余計な世話だったかもなァ。喉が渇いてるみたいだったんでねェ」
lines.english: “Ah, maybe I stuck my nose where it wasn't wanted. You looked thirsty, see.”
“Oh.”

lines.japanese: 喉の渇きが潤っている。そういえば、元は自動販売機でジュースを買おうとしてたんだった。
lines.english: My thirst had been quenched. Come to think of it, I had originally been trying to buy a drink from a vending machine.

lines.japanese: 「ありがとうございます……」
lines.english: “Thank you...”

lines.japanese: 咽ながらお礼を言うと、針生さんは煩わしそうに首をふらりふらりと左右に動かした。
lines.english: I thanked him between choking coughs. As though the gratitude were a nuisance, Hariu let his head drift slowly from side to side.
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「おまえは、あんなところで何をしてたかって聞いてるんだよ」
lines.english: “I'm asking what you were doing back there.”

lines.japanese: 「あんなところで……」
lines.english: “What I was doing...”

lines.japanese: 何をしていたんだろう。携帯電話の調子がおかしいから、携帯ショップに行こうとして……。
lines.english: What had I been doing? Something was wrong with my phone, so I had tried to go to a phone shop...

lines.japanese: いや、携帯ショップに行っても、森里君の電波が通じないんじゃどうしようもないじゃないか。僕は一体何をしていたんだろう。
lines.english: No. Even at a phone shop, there was nothing anybody could do if Morisato was outside the service area. What in the world had I been doing?

lines.japanese: 「いえ、そのう、ちょっと……」
lines.english: “Well, I... It was just...”

lines.japanese: 「あの、助かりました」
lines.english: “Um... you saved me.”

lines.japanese: 僕は今さらながらに針生さんに助けられたことが分かった。そうか、取りみだしちゃってたんだなあ……こんなこと、初めてだ。
lines.english: Only then did I understand that Hariu had rescued me. So I had lost control... That had never happened to me before.

lines.japanese: 彼は僕の困ったような謝辞に対しても、薄い笑いを漏らしただけだった。
lines.english: He answered my embarrassed thanks with nothing more than a thin laugh.

lines.japanese: 「じゃあな」
lines.english: “See you around.”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あの！　待ってください！」
lines.english: “W-wait, please!”

lines.japanese: 「んン？　なんだい？」
lines.english: “Hmm? What is it?”

lines.japanese: 「あの……おれの話を聞いてもらえませんか」
lines.english: “Would you... listen to what I have to say?”

lines.japanese: 針生さんは顎に手をあてて首を捻った。
lines.english: Hariu set a hand to his chin and tilted his head.

lines.japanese: 「ふうン……なんだァ、おまえから。いいよ、俺も話したいことはあんだ。言ってみな」
lines.english: “Hmmm... You, asking me? Fine. I've got something I want to talk about too. Let's hear it.”

lines.japanese: 針生さんは壁に寄りかかると、右の手の平を上にして差し出してきた。どうぞ、ということなんだろう。
lines.english: Hariu leaned against the wall and offered his right hand, palm upward. Presumably that meant, Go ahead.

lines.japanese: 「あの、きのうちょっとだけ話した……その、おれの秘密、なんですけど」
lines.english: “It's about... my secret. The one I told you a little about yesterday.”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、グレタガルド。それがどうした」
lines.english: “Ah, Gretagard. What about it?”

lines.japanese: 「すみません、あれは全部おれの妄想だったんです」
lines.english: “I'm sorry. All of it was a delusion.”

lines.japanese: 「へえ」
lines.english: “Oh?”

lines.japanese: 針生さんの鋭い三白眼が、じろりと奥深くを覗きこんできた。
lines.english: Hariu’s sharp eyes, white showing beneath the irises, bored deep into me.

lines.japanese: 「何故そう思う」
lines.english: “Why do you think that?”

lines.japanese: 「何故っていうか、それが本当のことだって気がついたからです。渡来さんにはっきりとそう言われました」
lines.english: “It isn't that I think so. I realized it was the truth. Watarai told me so plainly.”

lines.japanese: 「ははァ、明日香がねえ……なるほど、なるほど、あいつもその気になったってことか」
lines.english: “Aha. Asuka did, did she...? I see, I see. So she's finally made up her mind too.”

lines.japanese: 「それでおまえはどうしたァ？　妄想だと言われて、はいそうですかと納得できるようなモンでもないでしょう」
lines.english: “And what did you do? Being told it's a delusion isn't the sort of thing you can swallow with a simple 'Oh, is that so?'”

lines.japanese: 「それが、おれの中には別の人格がいるみたいで、そのひとと話して納得させられちゃったんです。自分でも驚いてるんですけど……」
lines.english: “It seems there's another personality inside me. I spoke to him, and he convinced me. I'm surprised myself...”

lines.japanese: 「なに、別の人格だァ？」
lines.english: “What? Another personality?”

lines.japanese: 「ハハ、そいつは何てやつだ。ナリタか？　それともイタミってやつか？」
lines.english: “Ha ha! And what's this one called? Narita? Or is it a fellow named Itami?”

lines.japanese: 「え……いや、千歳くんっていうひとですけど……」
lines.english: “What...? No, his name is Chitose...”

lines.japanese: 「ハハッ、ハッハッハ！　なんだ、さらにもうひとりいるってことかァ！　一体いくつの人格が潜んでるってんだ、なァ、オイ？　つくづくおまえは退屈しないやつだよ」
lines.english: “Ha! Hah-hah-hah! So there's another one in there! Just how many personalities have you got lurking inside you? Well? You really are never boring.”
“What?”

lines.japanese: 「あ、あの、どういうことですか。それっておれの他の人格にあったことが」
lines.english: “W-wait. What do you mean? Have you met one of my other personalities?”

lines.japanese: 「ああ、ある」
lines.english: “Yes.”

lines.japanese: 「しかもそのうち一人はァ、この俺の脇っ腹にドタマをぶち込んだやつだ。ハハ、おっと、調子に乗りすぎて余計なことまで話したかァ、ふふふ、浮かれてるんだろォなあ、俺」
lines.english: “And one of them rammed his skull straight into my ribs. Ha ha! Whoops. Maybe I got carried away and said too much. Heh heh. Must be in high spirits, eh?”

lines.japanese: 「おれが針生さんに怪我をさせたんですか！？」
lines.english: “I injured you?!”

lines.japanese: 「あァ？」
lines.english: “Huh?”

lines.japanese: 針生さんの目が不機嫌に細まったので、僕は少したじろいだ。
lines.english: Hariu's eyes narrowed with displeasure, and I shrank back a little.

lines.japanese: 「分かんねえやつだな、おまえじゃねえって言ってんだろ。自惚れるなよ、羽田に攻撃されたところで、一発だってもらうもんかよ」
lines.english: “You really don't get it, do you? I said it wasn't you. Don't flatter yourself. If Haneda came at me, he wouldn't land so much as one blow.”

lines.japanese: 「す、すみません」
lines.english: “I-I'm sorry.”

lines.japanese: 僕が謝ると、針生さんは小さく笑いながら鳩尾のあたりをぎゅっと押さえた。それは傷が痛んだからか、単に思いだしただけなのかは分からない。
lines.english: When I apologized, Hariu gave a quiet laugh and pressed one hand tightly over his solar plexus. I could not tell whether the wound hurt or whether he had merely remembered it.

lines.japanese: 「それで今度は誰が出てくるってんだ？　俺は誰でもいいけどまァ、面白いやつに越したことはないねェ」
lines.english: “So who's coming out next? I don't much care who, though the more entertaining he is, the better.”

lines.japanese: 「いえ、それは……」
lines.english: “No, that's...”

lines.japanese: 僕自身、分からなかった。この先どうなるのか。僕はどうなってしまうのか。
lines.english: I did not know myself. What would happen from here? What would become of me?

lines.japanese: 「んん？　どうした、いじけた子供みたいなツラして」
lines.english: “Hmm? What's wrong? You look like some sulking little kid.”

lines.japanese: 「そう見えますか」
lines.english: “Do I?”

lines.japanese: 針生さんの例えは的確だ。実際いまの僕はいじけた子供と、そう変わらない。
lines.english: Hariu's comparison was exactly right. At that moment, I truly was little different from a sulking child.

lines.japanese: 今までなら、僕はその事実を突き付けられても完璧に気付かないふりでやり過ごせただろう。けれど今回もそうしてしまったなら……きっと。
lines.english: Before now, even with that truth thrust before me, I could have acted as though I hadn’t noticed a thing and gotten through it. But if I did that again this time... surely...

lines.japanese: 「千歳くんが言うには、おれの中では、他のひとたちが人格を一つに戻そうとしているみたいなんです」
lines.english: “According to Chitose, the other people inside me are trying to put the personalities back together as one.”

lines.japanese: 「はァ……そいつはナリタかもう一人の提案だろうな。陛下が納得するとは思えない」
lines.english: “Huh... Narita's idea, I'd guess. Or the other one's. Can't imagine His Majesty agreeing to it.”

lines.japanese: 「そのときに自分の意思をしっかり保てって言われたんですけど、おれは自分がどうすればいいか……」
lines.english: “He told me that when the time came, I had to hold fast to my own will. But I don't know what I should do...”

lines.japanese: 「どうするもこうするも、おまえが決めろよ。部屋の片隅でいじけてたって、誰も救っちゃアくれないだろォ」
lines.english: “What do you mean, what should you do? Decide for yourself. You can sulk in the corner of your room all you like; nobody's coming to save you.”

lines.japanese: 「選択権があるだけいいんじゃないの。もうこの世界に飽きたってんなら、そっと消えるのも一興だァ」
lines.english: “At least you've got a choice. If you're already tired of this world, quietly disappearing might be an amusement in its own right.”
